children: Capital Economics says the Oct. 28 Bank of Canada policy decision should be considered "live," meaning traders need to be on alert for a possible rate increase. Economist Stephen Brown points to remarks during Gov. Tiff Macklem's press conference, in which the central banker says the next set of forecasts due in October will "really guide our decisions. Our beacon is our 2% inflation target." The forecast is released at the same time as the policy decision. Macklem's remarks on their own "suggests that we should treat every BOC meeting from here as 'live' in terms of a potential rate increase." (paul.vieira@wsj.com; @paulvieira)
